chunks: A hadith narrated through a chain: The venerable Sheikh Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Shadhawayh al-Mu'addib (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abdallah ibn Jafar ibn Jami al-Himyari narrated to us, from his father, saying: Yaqub ibn Yazid narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umar, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, who said:

When thirty years had passed for Isa (peace be upon him), Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent him to the Children of Israel. Iblis (may Allah curse him) met him at the mountain pass of Bayt al-Maqdis — the pass of Afiq — and said: O Isa, are you not the one whose lordship is so great that you came into being without a father? Isa replied: Rather, the greatness belongs to Him who brought me into being; likewise He created Adam and Eve. Iblis said: O Isa, are you not the one who spoke in the cradle as a baby? Isa said: Rather, greatness belongs to Him who made me speak in my infancy. Iblis said: Are you not the one who fashions birds from clay? Isa said: Rather, greatness belongs to Him who created me. Iblis said: Are you not the one who heals the sick?

Isa (peace be upon him) said: Rather, the greatness belongs to Him who heals them by His permission, and if He wills He causes me to be sick. Iblis said: Are you not the one who revives the dead? Isa said: Rather, the greatness belongs to Him who revives them by His permission, and inevitably He will cause to die what I have revived. Iblis said: Are you not the one who walks across the sea? Isa said: Rather, the greatness belongs to Him who tamed it for me. Iblis said: O Isa, there will come a day when heavens and earth and all therein will be below you, and you above all of it governing affairs and distributing provisions? Isa (peace be upon him) considered great this saying of the accursed disbeliever Iblis,

and then he said: Glory be to Allah, filling His heavens and His earths, and the ink of His words, and the weight of His Throne, and the pleasure of His Self. Ibn Abbas said: When Iblis (may Allah curse him) heard that, he left in utter loss of self-control until he fell into the depths of the green sea. A woman from the jinn came walking along the seashore and found Iblis prostrate on a hard rock with his tears flowing down his cheeks. She stood looking at him in amazement, then said: Woe to you, O Iblis! What do you hope for by this prolonged prostration? He said to her: O righteous woman, daughter of a righteous man, I hope that when I fulfil my Lord's — Mighty and Majestic — oath and He enters me into Hellfire, He will take me out of the Fire by His mercy.

key_terms.إبليس: 伊卜利斯——撒旦，被诅咒者
key_terms.ربوبيتك: 鲁布比耶——伊卜利斯将神性归于尔萨
key_terms.سبحان الله: 赞主洁净——尔萨的回答，宣告真主伟大

ai.seo_question: 根据伊本·阿巴斯的述说，伊卜利斯是如何试探先知尔萨的？
ai.summary: 这段伊本·阿巴斯传述的圣训讲述了先知尔萨（耶稣）与伊卜利斯在耶路撒冷附近的阿菲克山岡上的相遇。伊卜利斯用七个问题试探尔萨，每次都将神圣属性归于他。尔萨每次都将伟大归于真主。在最后的考验中，尔萨诵读了赞主词，伊卜利斯便落入大海。
